name: Malampaya shallow-water platform (original gas processing platform)
location: Approx. 50-80 km offshore northwest of Palawan, western Philippines
description: substructure_type: Concrete gravity substructure (CGS), rectangular caisson with four shafts | topside_type: Three-level integrated deck (weather, production, cellar decks) plus accommodation module | water_depth: 43 m at platform; subsea wells at approx. 820-850 m | topside_weight: 13,000 t initial operating weight; load-out weight 10,000 t excluding transportation frame (Offshore Technology); 11,500 t at installation (Offshore Magazine, KBR) — source-specific values | installation_method: Float-over of integrated topsides by KBR in mid-March 2001 using H-541 barge; 36 pumps transferred >21,000 t/h seawater; full weight transfer in 57 minutes; CGS installed summer 2000 on seabed prepared with 17,000 t rock in 361 mounds; 75,000 t iron ore ballast in open cells; 3,000 t rock scour protection | contractor: Brown & Root / KBR (EPCI, $432m contract awarded Aug 1998); topsides fabrication Se
